comportamentos: ResearchLine model belonging to ResearchArea, with table, CRUD controller, routes, navigation and permissions: present (but the candidate requires a `code` field, which the official fix removes, so lines created without a code fail validation)
Enrollment gets an optional research_line association, column and form/list fields: present

Validation that the enrollment's line belongs to its research area: present but different (error goes on :research_line with key research_line_different_from_research_area, while the official uses :research_area with :different_research_areas)
Area inferred from the line when the enrollment has no area set: missing
Line options on the enrollment form filtered by the selected area (update_columns plus custom select helpers): missing
`available` flag on research areas and lines, with filtering of available options: missing
ProfessorResearchLine and CourseResearchLine models, controllers and associations: missing
ResearchLine has_many enrollments with dependent: :nullify: differs (candidate uses restrict_with_exception)
justificativa: The candidate builds the basic ResearchLine model and adds it to enrollments, but it does not filter lines by the selected area or infer the area from the line, uses different error keys, requires a `code` field, and lacks the available flags and the professor/course line links.
